id_and_class.summary: Jorge Moll proposes that in a block universe, where all moments are equally real, a separate instance of each conscious self exists at every moment, and each instance experiences only its own ‘now’. Because these tracks cannot access one another, each feels its moment as the privileged present, which reconciles felt time with eternalist physics.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Many Selves, Each in Its Own Now

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Moll does not identify consciousness with any substance. He claims that conscious experience is instantiated as many moment-bound tracks spread across spacetime, each confined to a single now.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Left open: materialists can read the tracks as neural information embedded in spacetime, dualists as a further substance of conscious information, and idealists or panpsychists as manifestations of a universal consciousness.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Unclear (the conjecture is designed to fit both emergentist and fundamentalist views)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Each track is a unique instance of the self tied to one moment. The overarching self is a composite of all these temporally distributed experiences.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Moll treats the felt present as real and phenomenologically undeniable, but he does not try to solve the hard problem of why experience exists.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: A four-dimensional block (or growing-block) spacetime and multiple temporally localized instances of the conscious self.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through logical analysis of two postulates: block-universe physics and the undeniable reality of present-moment experience.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Isolated tracks of consciousness along a single worldline, likened to many record needles each playing a different groove of the same vinyl record.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Temporal experience (the felt now); personal identity; memory and emotion across time
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Track isolation: each temporally localized instance of the self lacks access to the others, so each experiences its own moment as the present.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: No flow occurs in the block itself. The impression of flow comes from each track being bound to one moment.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Distributed along the self’s worldline in spacetime, one instance per moment.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: From a ‘God’s view’ of block time, memories and emotions integrate across all tracks into a web of interrelated conscious states.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Interactions between individuals, and between any elements of reality, may form informational meshes across spacetime, which Moll speculates could ground continuities of personal and collective identity.
core_claims_and_evidence: If all moments are equally real and present experience is real, we face the ‘privileged now paradox’ of why one moment feels present.
Positing many isolated, moment-bound instances of the self resolves the paradox without denying block time.
The basic conjecture works within a single worldline but may also apply to branching-time interpretations of quantum mechanics.
Moll speculates that rare interference between tracks could account for déjà vu, altered states, or psi-like experiences.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Logical and philosophical argument from physics (relativity) and phenomenology

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The conjecture multiplies selves to explain one appearance, and nothing observable distinguishes it from rival accounts of the present. Its suggested link to anomalous experiences rests on phenomena that are themselves controversial.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Moll states that the conjecture does not address the hard problem of consciousness and asks whether solving the privileged now paradox could point toward an answer.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Internally consistent with eternalist physics and deliberately neutral across materialism, dualism, idealism, and panpsychism.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: In a block universe every conscious moment remains real, and Moll speculates that shared conscious information embedded in spacetime may carry continuities of identity.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: The view reframes identity as a web of conscious states in spacetime but stays neutral on any cosmic purpose.
